datasets/data/variables.csv.notes: Catalogue: one row per indicator (variable). Spec: csv-column-contract.md section 3.1.

datasets/data/concepts.csv.notes: Catalogue: one row per concept (what is measured). Spec: csv-column-contract.md section 3.1.

datasets/data/topics.csv.notes: Catalogue: one row per topic (Gapminder parent-pointer shape). Spec: csv-column-contract.md section 3.1.

datasets/data/entities/geo.csv.notes: LGD administrative ladder. v1 freezes entity_kind at state + district per F4 (sub-district + village admissible but not emitted yet). census_2001_code + census_2011_code are two dated LABEL columns joined from the LGD parsed snapshot (B2b.5.0c); NEVER join keys (they renumber + go null for post-2011 entities). eci_st_code is NOT carried (round-8 decommission). Spec: csv-column-contract.md section 3.2.

datasets/data/entities/state_codes.csv.notes: LGD-spine state/UT identity (B2b.5.0b). PK lgd_state_id (LGD-issued). iso_3166_2 is ISO-issued (yen-gov transcribes via datasets/data/entities/state_iso_seed.csv; G8 2026-06-08: was datasets/reference/state-iso-seed.csv). eci_st_code is DROPPED (round-8: no authoritative ECI state-code registry). census_2001_code + census_2011_code are two dated LABEL columns (NEVER exact-match keys; renumber across censuses + go null for post-2011 entities); aliases is a pipe-delimited synonym column. Spec: TODO/20260604-b2b5-elections-reingest-subplan.md section 0c.4.

datasets/data/entities/electoral.csv.notes: ECI AC and PC entities per delimitation cycle. LGD-native PK (no arithmetic surrogate id). eci_no is the natural ECI ballot serial folded from the PRI super-file (round-7); the candidacies bind resolves through (state, delim_year, eci_no). Electoral and LGD-district entities meet only via electoral_district_membership.csv (F3). Spec: TODO/20260604-b2b5-elections-reingest-subplan.md section 0c.

datasets/data/entities/electoral_distric.notes: AC <-> LGD-district 1:many membership (round-7 rename of electoral_lgd_xwalk.csv). LGD-canonical (an AC can span districts per the LGD Constituency Coverage report), NOT a geometry artifact. is_primary = the plurality district. Composite PK: (electoral_id, lgd_district_id). Spec: TODO/20260604-b2b5-elections-reingest-subplan.md section 0c.

datasets/data/entities/electoral_lgd_xwa.notes: Versioned crosswalk - NEVER an invariant. Composite PK: (electoral_id, lgd_district_id, delim_year). Spec: csv-column-contract.md section 3.2.

datasets/data/entities/parties.csv.notes: Sole party key is party_id (plan section 20.3); eci_code is NOT a PK. aliases is a pipe-delimited list of UPPERCASE alternate shortcodes (e.g. TCPD's dialect: CPM, ADMK, AAAP for the canonical CPI(M), AIADMK, AAP) consumed by the elections writer's party_lookup expansion (G1, 2026-06-08). v1.1 (PR-0 of TODO/20260610-electoral-data-quality-and-party-catalogue-plan.md, 2026-06-10): 10 nullable identity-metadata columns appended (recognition_scope, home_state_codes, founded_year, dissolved_year, predecessor_party_ids, successor_party_ids, name_history, claims_to_parent_name, name_native_script, is_sentinel) per Hans + Gregor Wave 0 verdict; the 3 hardcoded resolver sentinels (parties.IN.UNK, parties.IN.IND, parties.IN.NOTA) are lifted into rows here so FK closure now includes them. is_sentinel marks the 3 resolver-fallback rows; recognition_scope=sentinel is reserved for them. name_history JSON-blob shape: [{"from": "YYYY", "to": "YYYY", "short": "...", "full": "...", "source_id": "..."}]. predecessor_party_ids / successor_party_ids are pipe-delimited lists of parties.IN.<X> slugs (lineage; not enforced as FK at v1.1 because the writer does not yet validate pipe-delimited FK refs). claims_to_parent_name = true for the ECI-favoured side of a contested split. Spec: csv-column-contract.md section 3.2.

datasets/data/entities/parties_leadershi.notes: Term-shape party-leadership register (one row per (party, leadership term)). Composite PK (party_id, valid_from); valid_to nullable (null = currently serving, never datetime.now per CLAUDE.md anti-pattern). Sole writer: backend/yen_gov/sources/wikidata/party_leadership.py per PR-7 of TODO/20260613-party-deferred-followups-plan.md (Max 2a / 2d / 2e verdicts). Source axis: Wikidata SPARQL pinned snapshot (P488 chairperson PRIMARY, P3975 secretary general FALLBACK; P39 qualifier carries the role label, P580 / P582 the term bounds). role is free-text since Wikidata position labels are open-ended ('President', 'General Secretary', 'National Convenor', 'Working President'); no enum closure. person_wikidata_qid nullable so hand-curated overrides without a Wikidata entry can still land. source_id FKs into source.csv per CLAUDE.md section 12; nullable so a hand-curated row can land before its source ledger entry exists (rare). PR-7 ships the schema rails + ingester only; PR-9 will pin the first SPARQL snapshot and emit data rows. Frontend consumer: PR-11 (party tooltip).

datasets/data/entities/party_alliances.c.notes: Per-event party alliance memberships (composite PK: party_id + event_id + state). One row per (party, election event, state) triple where an alliance was declared; alliance null = party contested unallied. v2.0 (2026-06-12, plan TODO/20260612-alliance-phase-1-structural-fix-plan.md): MAJOR breaking - renamed period_label -> event_id so the column joins citizen-route canonical event_id values (`general-2024`, `assembly-2024`); added state (LGD state slug like `tamil-nadu` for state-scoped events, literal `IN` for national events) to disambiguate per-state cohorts that share an event_id (e.g. 5-state May 2026 simultaneous cohort); dropped short_name (Holy Law #6 - readers join through party_id FK to parties.csv.short_name). Frontend JOIN: state-overview view-model reads via inline read_csv(...) keyed on (party_id, event_id, state).

datasets/data/entities/source.csv.notes: Provenance ledger (citation grain, one row per producer/title/vintage). Exactly five columns per plan section 7 (O3). source_id is derived (B2a builder), never hand-authored (CLAUDE.md Holy Law #9, section 12). Spec: csv-column-contract.md section 3.2.

datasets/data/entities/boundary_layer.cs.notes: Boundary-shard inventory ledger (one row per geometry shard on disk). 18-column 1:1 transcode of the retired datasets/boundaries/boundary_layers.parquet (X1a-fu2-E, 2026-06-07). source_id FKs into entities/source.csv; the 8 boundary citation triples are seeded by the B2a/source_csv path. simplification_tolerance_deg is the only floating-point column (degrees of arc); all counts are integer (size_bytes was BIGINT in parquet, encoded as integer here since the CSV column contract has no bigint dtype). Producer: backend/yen_gov/canonical/boundary_layers_seed.py::compile_to_csv (REPLACE writer; merge-with-existing handled at the caller layer via _read_existing_boundary_layers helper). Spec: ADR-0031 Amendment 2026-05-22.

datasets/data/entities/boundary_encoding.notes: Committed producer receipt for boundary render encodings. One row per TopoJSON shard under datasets/boundaries/in/** with its GeoJSON sibling path, TopoJSON object key, structural feature counts, byte hashes, mapshaper pin, and config hash. Produced by python -m tools.topojson.emit_receipt; validated by backend Tier-B tier_b_boundary_encoding_receipt. layer_id is nullable because boundary_layer.csv is an inventory ledger whose historical path vocabulary does not resolve every current slugged boundary path.

datasets/data/entities/office.csv.notes: Office register per plan section 20.4 (one row per office). Sourced from datasets/governments/dim_offices.parquet by B2b.3 reingest. jurisdiction_entity_id FKs into geo.csv (state or country grain). office_kind is open-ended (cm|pm|president|vice_president|cabinet_minister|...); enum NOT closed at v1 to admit future cabinet/PM rows without a schema bump.

datasets/data/entities/holder.csv.notes: Office-holder register per plan section 20.4 (one row per distinct person-slug). Sourced from datasets/governments/governments_office_holdings.parquet by B2b.3 reingest. party_id is nullable (a holder may have no party affiliation at the time of holding) and FKs into parties.csv.

datasets/data/datapoints/office_holdings.notes: Term-shape datapoint per plan section 20.4: one row per (office, term_start). term_end null = incumbent (never datetime.now per CLAUDE.md anti-pattern). Sourced from datasets/governments/governments_office_holdings.parquet by B2b.3 reingest. Single-file datapoint family (not a per-variable glob), so the datapoint-filename-equals-indicator_id rule does not apply.

datasets/data/datapoints/alliance_member.notes: Term-shape datapoint per plan section 20.4: one row per (alliance, party, term_start). Alliance membership shares the term-shape spine with office_holdings.csv but is NOT a fourth entity table - alliance_id is a free-text short label (NDA, UPA, SPA, AIADMK+, Mahagathbandhan, etc.) since no upstream issuing authority publishes a stable alliance-identity register. term_end null = open / still active at the latest evidence we have (never datetime.now per CLAUDE.md anti-pattern). Back-filled by backend/yen_gov/canonical/alliance_membership_csv.py from datasets/taxonomy/office_holdings.json (per-CM-tenure alliance with real start_date/end_date boundaries) and datasets/data/entities/party_alliances.csv (per-election-event snapshot resolved to polled_on date via election_events.json). Single-file datapoint family (not a per-variable glob); the datapoint-filename-equals-indicator_id rule does not apply.

datasets/data/marts/party_pages/history..notes: Derived party-page history read model. Generated by `python -m yen_gov derive-party-pages --root .` from canonical electoral datapoint CSVs; never hand-authored. Vote share is votes-weighted from party-votes-polled over AC/PC votes-polled within the state. Per-state grain (one row per party_id x body x period_label x state) so consumers can re-aggregate across multi-state events losslessly via SUM(party_votes) / SUM(total_votes). state is the slug from datasets/taxonomy/lgd_states.json (e.g. tamil-nadu). body enum uses English code vocabulary per the No-Hindi policy.

datasets/data/marts/party_pages/strongho.notes: Derived party-page stronghold read model. Generated by `python -m yen_gov derive-party-pages --root .` from canonical winner rows and electoral entities. entity_id keeps the peer election-results id shape because the frontend link resolver already consumes that shape; constituency_name/state are materialised to avoid browser joins over the full electoral corpus.

datasets/data/marts/party_pages/manifest.notes: Freshness receipt for the party-page derived marts. input_signature is a sha256 over input relative paths and file-content hashes. Tier-B validation fails when the signature is stale.

datasets/data/datapoints/geo/*.csv.notes: Long-format datapoints keyed to LGD geo entities. One file per variable_id; filename is exactly <variable_id>.csv. Sorted by (entity_id, time). Per-indicator facet columns (e.g. sex, fuel_type) extend the core list dynamically and join the PK when present (plan section 21.6); facet metadata lives on the indicator's variables.csv row, not in this file class. Spec: csv-column-contract.md section 3.3.

datasets/data/datapoints/electoral/*.csv.notes: Per-state election-results long-format CSV. One file per state (filename <state_slug>_election_results.csv). 9-column mechanical transcode of the X1a-fu2-D-retired election_results.parquet (2026-06-07). entity_id is a synthetic state-event-party row id (e.g. IN-S22-AcGenMay2026-PARTY-DMK), NOT an electoral.csv FK; therefore no entity_id FK is declared. value_numeric / value_text carry the observation. period_label is the canonical event id (AcGenMay2026, AcByeOct1971, etc.). derivation describes the methodology (count, share, etc.). For indicator_id rows ending in -winner-party-id / -leading-party-id / -runnerup-party-id, value_text carries an embedded parties.IN.<X> reference; the Tier-B FK validator special-cases this embedded-FK shape via per-indicator dispatch, so no column-level fk declaration is needed on value_text here (PR-0 of TODO/20260610-electoral-data-quality-and-party-catalogue-plan.md).

datasets/elections/assembly/state=*/elec.notes: Per-election self-contained CSV (wide: one row per constituency x candidate). Delimitation merge/split never reconciled in-file (plan section 21.3). party_short_raw carries the VERBATIM upstream TCPD Party label even when party_id is null (PR-R.2 v1.1 precedent on the retired dim_candidates parquet, reintroduced for CSV on G1, 2026-06-08); citizen UI MUST use it as the display fallback so long-tail fringe parties not yet in parties.csv still render with a usable name. processing_level + processing_note follow OWID's variable.processing_level vocabulary (https://docs.owid.io/projects/etl/architecture/metadata/reference/variable/#variable-processingLevel) verbatim - 'minor' = mechanical (typed read + party-id resolution), 'major' = curator/structural reshape (UNK fallback, historical break, alliance attribution). Single named divergence: PER-ROW scope, not OWID's per-variable scope (canonical CSV is long-format and individual rows in the same file may have different processing fates). See docs/concepts/data-quality.md. Spec: csv-column-contract.md section 3.4.

Derived projection of candidacies.csv (parity-oracle-CSV gate asserts summary == recompute(candidacies)). winner_party_short_raw + runnerup_party_short_raw mirror the candidacies.party_short_raw column (G1, 2026-06-08) so the citizen UI never falls back to displaying a NULL party. processing_level + processing_note follow OWID's variable.processing_level vocabulary verbatim (https://docs.owid.io/projects/etl/architecture/metadata/reference/variable/#variable-processingLevel); see candidacies.csv notes for the per-row vs per-variable scope divergence. Summary rows inherit the winner candidacy's processing_level by construction (parity-oracle gate). Spec: csv-column-contract.md section 3.4.

datasets/elections/parliament/election=*.notes: Same shape as assembly candidacies. constituency_no is ECI pc_no (per-state-restart, so 'state' is MANDATORY even though the path lacks a state= partition - plan section 23.4). entity_id follows IN-PC-<delim>-<state_code>-<pc_no>. party_short_raw carries the verbatim upstream TCPD Party label (G1, 2026-06-08); see assembly candidacies.csv notes. processing_level + processing_note follow OWID's variable.processing_level vocabulary verbatim; see assembly candidacies.csv notes for the per-row vs per-variable scope divergence + docs/concepts/data-quality.md. Spec: csv-column-contract.md section 3.4.

Same shape as assembly summary with entity_id keyed to PC. state is MANDATORY (plan section 23.4). winner_share_pct + the runnerup_* + margin_* fields are nullable: an uncontested seat (single candidate, unopposed return) has no runner-up and no meaningful margin, and TCPD records an unopposed winner's share as non-numeric (B2b.5.3). winner_party_short_raw + runnerup_party_short_raw mirror the candidacies.party_short_raw column (G1, 2026-06-08). processing_level + processing_note follow OWID's variable.processing_level vocabulary verbatim; summary rows inherit the winner candidacy's level. Spec: csv-column-contract.md section 3.4.

ECI MCC-period daily enforcement-seizures press-note series (17th Lok Sabha General Election 2019). One row per (state_slug, date) pair across the publisher-reported MCC enforcement window (29-Mar-2019 through 07-Apr-2019 in the 2019 vintage; 36 states/UTs x 10 dates = 360 rows). The publisher's TOTAL column is preserved verbatim per D3 ('no derived totals') - total_seizure_inr_crore is NOT computed at write time and consumers MUST NOT recompute it (publisher rounds intermediate sums and may diverge from components by a few thousandths of a crore). state_slug is the LGD state-name slug (e.g. tamil-nadu) for current-spine UTs and the HISTORICAL slug for pre-2020-merger UTs (dadra-and-nagar-haveli, daman-and-diu) since the publisher's 2019 rows are historically distinct; no FK declared here because the column carries per-event publisher-distinct identity, not a state_codes.csv reference. date is ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Empty publisher cells map to NULL (NOT 0) since the press-note uses blank for 'no action reported' (publisher silence, not zero-seizure). PK is (state_slug, date) in that declaration order so rows sort state-major then date-minor on emit. Spec: TODO/20260614-three-ephemeral-ingests-plan.md section 2.A.1.

datasets/data/methodology_breaks.csv.notes: Rosling-rule break register (one row per methodology break; F6 reference). Sourced from datasets/taxonomy/methodology_breaks.parquet by B2b.4.1 reingest. publisher_url + supersedes_methodology_version are nullable; the remaining five columns form the contract spine.

datasets/data/facet_axes.csv.notes: Facet axis register (one row per (axis, value) pair). Sourced from datasets/taxonomy/facet-axes.parquet by B2b.4.2 reingest (filename loses the hyphen per parent plan 21.6 underscore convention). Verbatim 1:1 projection of all eight columns; no re-keys; no FKs.

datasets/data/election_events.csv.notes: Per-state election event register (one row per (state_entity_id, event_id)). Sourced from datasets/taxonomy/election_events.parquet by B2b.4.4 reingest. The source ECI state_code is re-keyed to the LGD state slug on emit and renamed to state_entity_id (FK into geo.csv). polled_on / term_end_estimated are emitted as ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) strings since the column contract has no native date dtype (csv-column-contract section 4).

datasets/data/state_tiers.csv.notes: M:N tier -> state register (one row per (tier, state) pair). Sourced from datasets/taxonomy/state_tiers.parquet by B2b.4.3 reingest. The source ECI state_code is re-keyed to the LGD state slug on emit and renamed to state_entity_id (FK into geo.csv).

datasets/data/indicator_topic_tags.csv.notes: M:N tag enrichment - one row per (topic_id, artifact_kind, artifact_id). Sourced from datasets/taxonomy/indicator_topic_tags.parquet by B2b.4.5 reingest. Verbatim 1:1 projection of all nine columns; no re-keys. FK on topic_id into topics.csv is unconditional. The parquet's artifact_id FK semantics are conditional (resolves into variables.csv.indicator_id only when artifact_kind = 'indicator'; null when artifact_kind = 'election'); the column contract has no conditional-FK construct, so artifact_id is declared without an fk target here. Closure of that FK belongs with a validator extension (parent plan section 22.6 fk-validator follow-up); not blocking B2b.4 deletion-safety since the parity gate establishes byte equality against the surviving parquet.

datasets/data/entities/ac_crosswalk.csv.notes: Authoritative ECI-no -> LGD-AC-id mapping per delim (one row per (state_entity_id, delim_year, eci_no)). Sourced from datasets/taxonomy/ac_crosswalk.parquet by B2b.4.6 reingest. The source ECI state_code is re-keyed to the LGD state slug on emit and renamed to state_entity_id (FK into geo.csv). lgd_ac_id is nullable (some delim rows have no LGD reconciliation). This file is NOT the same as datasets/data/entities/electoral_lgd_xwalk.csv (boundary-overlap decay-receipt shape with 253 rows).
